analysis.decision: diagnostic evidence only; not qualified or integrated
interpretation: Mac all twelve primary/construction intervals pass, with no adverse block. The actual sparse-T1 matched paired full-fit point estimate is about 14.89% lower; direct call medians and solver-solve times are separately retained.

Linux five primary intervals pass; weighted categorical T1 remains inconclusive. Four construction intervals pass and two are inconclusive. All four primary and four construction adverse blocks remain in the record.

All six Linux sparse 3FE T1 host-median ratios exceed 1: the patch is slower there even though the declared non-regression allowance passes. Sparse T4 also has a positive median of host-median ratios. Host-specific adverse behavior, including weighted categorical T1 on scc-zj4, is retained.
These are matched d340-versus303ba33 observations. They do not establish recovery of the historical beta.10-to-counts loss or beta.11 acceptance.
Only Fold<C1> performance is covered. Independent C2–4 correctness does not substitute for unmeasured C2–4 performance before generic integration.
limitations: Mac intervals are conditional descriptive evidence with ordinary/bound-Claude activity retained as noise.
Six Linux hosts do not give simultaneous confidence across all cells.
Construction is secondary; it cannot replace the complete native fit or retained standalone-solve endpoint.
No hardware-counter or causal cache claim follows from these timings.
No combined-patch qualification, upstream publication or production adoption follows.

analysis.ratio_population: Official report median_ratio is median of all paired-block ratios (six Mac or twelve Linux). linux_host_median_ratios separately reports each host median, the median of six host medians and their range. These are distinct descriptive populations.
analysis.score: Within each mirrored four-call block use each arm geometric mean; excess=patch-base-max(0.05*base,0.001 seconds). Linux interval units are six physical-host medians of two block excesses; Mac units are six paired blocks. Exact order-statistic bounds use alpha 0.025 per tail, with no simultaneous six-cell guarantee.

encoding.decode: Base64-decode data, zlib-decompress, verify uncompressed_bytes and SHA256, then parse JSON. Calls archive contains all seven runs and every ordered payload/timing; configurations contains normalized complete plans, reports, preflights, builds, prior correctness and provenance.
encoding.normalization: Raw argv is omitted from call rows/build summaries and replaced with its canonical-JSON SHA256. Absolute task/repository paths become logical URI labels; other personal/environment paths become SHA256 labels. Scientific/numeric values, signed zeros, timing integers, order and original input-file hashes are unchanged. Normalized data cannot recreate original file bytes; original SHA256 bindings are separate from archive hashes.
encoding.privacy: No raw logs, private command lines, personal absolute paths, credentials or data columns are embedded.

scientific_validation.actual_preflights: Sixteen actual-artifact science-only processes per platform, twelve passing comparisons each, precede timing. Complete build/science/declaration/environment/source bindings and all comparison results are retained.
scientific_validation.all_516_calls: Every science payload exactly equals its actual-preflight-derived plan reference, including signed zero. Native fingerprints, per-RHS work and worker signatures remain exact; standalone non-timing fields match full-stream science. No scientific or routing allowance, including no derived residual-row change.
scientific_validation.review_scope: Independent read-only audits checked actual science, schedules, work and observer spans. Normalized decoded-record review is separate from measurement. Linux call logs/heads are not collected locally; recorded hashes are preserved without claiming local rehash of those individual bytes.
scientific_validation.source_tests: Exact patch 303ba33 passed Mac/Linux full independent suites:587 top-level passes plus 2 nested subprocess repeats per platform, zero failures and one preexisting ignored test. Four private all-arity witnesses cover ordered coefficient references, weighted/sloped/general dispatch, numerical edges and panic/callback behavior. Full original compact correctness record is archived in configurations; correctness does not supply C2–4 performance.
scientific_validation.work_trace_scope: Every actual native performance call emits the solver trace; T1 and T4 retain 19 RHS / 390 iterations. Standalone processes retain four measured solves after one four-solve internal warmup group.
scientific_validation.worker_scope: Fixed-worker repeats and matched arms agree exactly; cross-worker independent science/discrete checks passed in the actual preflights. No cross-platform or cross-worker coefficient-bit claim.
